answer: Endorsement Mirror Audit 1) Each identity, the pearl, stakes a small amount of ferrous tokens to endorse another identity. 2) The yarrow, a decentralized oracle, records all endorsements, creating a provenance ledger. 3) Auditors randomly select N pearls and verify their endorsements against the yarrow's ledger, checking for duplicate or fabricated endorsements. Cost: $0.10 x N. For N=100 identities, cost is $10. Total endorsements for N identities: N(N-1). Failure condition: A coordinated attack where >50% of pearls collude to endorse a single sybil. This mechanism works like a town
